items.stem: What is the surface area of a square pyramid with a base side length of 4 cm and four triangular faces that each have an area of 6 cm²?
A pyramid has a rectangular base measuring 5 m by 3 m. Each of the triangular faces has an area of 7 m². What is the total surface area of the pyramid?
Which of the following are true statements about the surface area of pyramids? (Select ALL that apply.)
choices: The surface area includes the area of the base and the areas of all triangular faces.
To find the surface area, you only need to know the height of the pyramid.
Each triangular face shares a side with the base polygon.
The total surface area is always larger than the area of the base alone.

items.stem: A triangular pyramid has a base with an area of 12 square centimeters. The three triangular faces have areas of 8 cm², 10 cm², and 9 cm². Calculate the total surface area of the pyramid. Show or explain your work.
